page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top with page number left. Text block centred; a rule, a chapter heading "XIII." and a title "EIDEM REGI." below the first paragraph; then salutation and running text.

main_text.p: Serenitatem vestram interpellari minime fas erat. Unde fit ut ne Maiestati vestrae molestiae quippiam afferatur, sed animo vacuo & ab aliis curis tuto legationis meae causae examinentur, libenter alio (si ita Maiestati vestrae videatur) migraturus sum, atque ibi donec revocer Serenitatis vestrae mandato commoraturus.
main_text.head: XIII.
EIDEM REGI.
Serenissime & Potentissime
REX.
main_text.p: CUm Berlino ad Illustrissimum Electorem Saxonicum iret, ex literis amicorum facta est mihi primum suspicio, Legationem meam quorundam calumniis apud Imperatorem in odium vocari; postea quam vero à Ma

page.notes: The page is damaged at the left edge and in places in the text; "Ma" at the end of the last line is cut off by the page edge. Some letters in the first line of the salutation are uncertain. The initial "C" of "Cum" is a large woodcut-style initial joined to "Um".
